newsitem.title: UK: Laura Ashley slides after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Laura Ashley slides after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Laura Ashley Plc fell sharply on Thursday after the clothing-to-furniture retailer warned full-year profits would be below market expectations.
The shares were down 26-1/2p to 118-1/2 by 0730 GMT.
"The company has admitted that it's tough out there, that competition is forcing it to cut prices," one market maker said.

The company reported a 57 percent jump in full-year, pre-tax profits but warned that the need to mark-down prices on its current clothing range would affect first-half trading and that earnings in the current year would be lower than expected.

"Although the current year will be difficult, we continue to remain a results driven group to ensure that we maximise the potential of this powerful brand," company chief executive Ann Iverson said in a statement.
